notes.title: MAY 2025 DEATH STRANDING ANNUAL PHOTO MODE CAMPAIGN
notes.content:
[h3][b]Campaign Details[/b][/h3]
Every month, KOJIMA PRODUCTIONS will announce a unique photo theme where Porters can share and submit their photos: 20 photos will then be selected each month. From those 20 selected photos, KOJIMA PRODUCTIONS staff will select one “Photo of the Month” winner each month.   

At the end of the calendar year, the 12 “Photo of the Month” photos will then be featured as the cover for each month on the 2026 KOJIMA PRODUCTIONS calendar. This calendar will be sent to the Photo of the Month winners as a prize. 

Also introduced this year is the new “Photo of the Year Award”, Hideo Kojima will select the top photo from the 12 “Photo of the month” photos! 

We look forward to seeing your photo entries!  

[h3][b]Campaign Period and Theme[/b][/h3]
Campaign dates: Jan 22, 2025, through until mid-December 2025

[list]
[*] May's Theme: Journey
[*] Submission period: May 9, 2025 〜 June 2, 2025
[*] Hashtag #DSPhotomodeCP_May , #DeathStranding
[/list]
June's Theme: To be released at a later date.
 
[h3][b]Campaign Rules [/b][/h3]
The following rules will apply for this Photo Mode campaign. 

[list]
[*] Please turn off the UI when taking your picture (Photo Mode menu settings). 
[*] Do not use frames and logos when taking your picture (Photo Mode menu settings). 
[*] Do not use other apps to edit the pictures other than the ones in the game’s Photo Mode.  
[*] Please submit your own photos(Submission will be invalid if you apply using other people’s pictures).  
[*] If you are capturing it vertically (i.e. portrait), go to the Roll menu and change the settings to tilt it 90° or -90° beforehand. 
[*] We recommend an aspect ratio of 16:9 (9:16 if vertical). 
[*] The works selected in the top 10 and “Photo of the Month” may be used on KOJIMA PRODUCTION's website and  social media channels.  
[*] Please save the image data.  *
[/list]

notes.title: THE 2025: DEATH STRANDING ANNUAL PHOTO MODE CAMPAIGN BEGINS!
notes.content:
[h3][b]The 2025: DEATH STRANDING Annual Photo Mode Campaign Begins![/b][/h3]

KOJIMA PRODUCTIONS is pleased to announce that the 2025: DEATH STRANDING Annual Photo Mode Campaign has begun!

Last year, over 10,000 creative photos were shared throughout the campaign. Many thanks to all the Porters out there who participated. Your photos inspire us and our community!

It’s through this campaign we see many connections made across our community so we would like to show our continued support by going a little bigger this year. 

[h3][b]Campaign Details[/b][/h3]
Every month, KOJIMA PRODUCTIONS will announce a unique photo theme where Porters can share and submit their photos: 20 photos will then be selected each month. From those 20 selected photos, KOJIMA PRODUCTIONS staff will select one “Photo of the Month” winner each month.   

At the end of the calendar year, the 12 “Photo of the Month” photos will then be featured as the cover for each month on the 2026 KOJIMA PRODUCTIONS calendar. This calendar will be sent to the Photo of the Month winners as a prize. 

Also introduced this year is the new “Photo of the Year Award”, Hideo Kojima will select the top photo from the 12 “Photo of the month” photos! 

We look forward to seeing your photo entries!  

[h3][b]Campaign Period and Theme[/b][/h3]
Campaign dates: Jan 22, 2025, through until mid-December 2025

[list]
[*] [b]January’s Theme: Vehicle[/b]
[*] Submission period: January 22, 2025 〜 February 10, 2025 .
[*] Hashtag #DSPhotomodeCP_Jan , #DeathStranding
[/list]
February’s Theme: To be released at a later date.
 
[h3][b]Campaign Rules [/b][/h3]
The following rules will apply for this Photo Mode campaign. 

[list]
[*] Please turn off the UI when taking your picture (Photo Mode menu settings). 
[*] Do not use frames and logos when taking your picture (Photo Mode menu settings). 
[*] Do not use other apps to edit the pictures other than the ones in the game’s Photo Mode.  
[*] Please submit your own photos(Submission will be invalid if you apply using other people’s pictures).  
[*] If you are capturing it vertically (i.e. portrait), go to the Roll menu and change the settings to tilt it 90° or -90° beforehand. 
[*] We recommend an aspect ratio of 16:9 (9:16 if vertical). 
[*] The works selected in the top 10 and “Photo of the Month” may be used on KOJIMA PRODUCTION's website and  social media channels.  
[*] Please save the image data.  *
[/list]
[i]*Please note that for the purpose of printing out the calendar, we may request that you provide the original file. (Image files are compressed when uploaded to social media)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41741388/58e205c6ee3f50544c089a8114394a6b137a6e00.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Awards and Prizes [/b][/h3]
「Photo of the month」 12 people 
Prize：DEATH STRANDING original calendar 
　　「2026 DEATH STRANDING Photo mode Campaign Calendar」 
 
「Photo of the year 2025」 1 person 
Prize： 
・DEATH STRANDING original calendar* 
　「2026 DEATH STRANDING Photo mode Campaign Calendar」
・Original goods* 
・We will make the photos into B2 posters and display them in the KOJIMA PRODUCTIONS office. 
[i]*Details of some of the prizes will be announced at a later date. 
*The “Photo of the Year 2025” calendar and goods will be signed by Hideo Kojima. 
*The prizes will be sent out in mid-January 2026. [/i]

[h3][b]How to Apply [/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Follow the official KOJIMA PRODUCTIONS account on the SNS you are applying through
X users:@KOJIPRO2015 
Instagram users: @kojipro2015_official 
Steam users: Here in the comments!
[*] Use the in-game photo mode to take a photo that fits the theme. 
[*] Post your entry to your own X or Instagram or Steam account, including the entry hashtag for each month. (Example) Entry for the January theme: [#DSPhotomodeCP_Jan] +[#DeathStranding]

notes.title: CELEBRATING 4 YEARS OF DEATH STRANDING ON PC
notes.content:
[h3][b]CELEBRATING 4 YEARS OF DEATH STRANDING ON PC[/b][/h3]

It’s hard to believe that on this day 4 years ago, we welcomed PC Porters into DEATH STRANDING for the very first time. Looking back, 2020 was such an incredibly challenging time for everyone around the world, but we took some comfort in knowing that DEATH STRANDING was connecting people in positive ways, whether it be through the power of the Social Strand System in-game or across our social media channels. It’s been wonderful to see. 

Ever since DEATH STRANDING landed on PC, we’ve been overwhelmed by your enthusiasm, passion and creativity for the game. It feels like we say this every year, but we’ve had the best time engaging with you all and we want to keep this momentum going for as long as possible. 

On behalf of the whole team at KOJIMA PRODUCTIONS and 505 Games, thank you for your ongoing love and support. It means everything to us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41741388/a2b2584f42d37a5f4fae14273d26348b4a70daa2.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]TIMELINE OF EVENTS[/b][/h3]

From celebrating our amazing Porters in our #DSPorterSpotlight series, to launching DEATH STRANDING onto more platforms, we’ve had quite an eventful 12 months. If you’re new around here, check out what we’ve been up to over the years: [url=https://505.games/DSPCTimeline]https://505.games/DSPCTimeline[/url]

[h3][b]DEATH STRANDING COMMUNITY SHOWCASE [/b][/h3]

Spotlighting Porters to applaud their creativity is something we enjoy hugely. As we head into our 5th year since launching DEATH STRANDING onto PC, we want to do more to celebrate our fans! While our #DSPorterSpotlight series might have come to an end in 2023, we're excited to announce our all-new DEATH STRANDING community showcase video series, designed to celebrate the talents of our fans. (And celebrate more of you!)

Whether you’re a cosplayer, artist, illustrator, or virtual photographer, we want to invite you to get involved, from today! 

Submit your best work here and who knows, you may just see your creations in one of our future monthly showcases: [url=https://505games.com/uploads/]https://505games.com/uploads/[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41741388/35c228e658cdcb650d253e8ee12b1e5a8e37422c.png[/img]

[h3][b]CALLING ALL COSPLAYERS[/b][/h3]

Speaking of community talent, if you’re a cosplayer attending Gamescom this year, the team would love to hear from you! Drop KOJIMA PRODUCTIONS a message on X and someone will be in touch via DM. 

More information can be found here: https://x.com/KojiPro2015_EN/status/1809034998735122488 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41741388/ce3f2816844bc127b90cb5e043ed85f6900be4d8.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]THE POWER OF CONNECTIONS[/b][/h3]

Back in 2022, we launched DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT onto PC, welcoming more Porters to this vibrant and healthy community. Since then, you’ve delivered on a scale that we never imagined! Take a look at these impressive stats from in-game, highlighting your amazing efforts and contributions over the years:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41741388/99c43b45c6407cbe724d1d55d4c9775ff0fcfc78.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41741388/16c17c34951ec4d9e996c9371b5b1cc94b9e230d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41741388/fba6d87f3ce19fd0d59db6a9821067dc0e445605.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]KEEP ON KEEPING ON[/b][/h3]

Let’s wrap up by once again saying thank you from the bottom of our hearts for your ongoing love for DEATH STRANDING. We don’t take your support for granted and we talk frequently behind the scenes about how special our Porters are. Every positive connection you make with us and one another is what makes this community so great. Please, don’t ever change! 

As we wrap up another year of reflection, we invite you to share your memories with us across social using #4YearsDSPC. We’ll share our favourite responses on X over the next couple of days. 

Thank you, Porters. 

Keep on keeping on!  

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1850570/DEATH_STRANDING_DIRECTORS_CUT/

notes.title: PORTER TIPS FOR THOSE NEW TO DEATH STRANDING ON PC
notes.content:
Hi everyone! In our latest Community Blog, we’re back with more advice for new players. Earlier this year, we asked the amazing DEATH STRANDING community over on Reddit to share their top tips for those about to jump in-game for the first time. 

We received more responses than we can include, so it was difficult to just highlight a selection of them! If you’re new to DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT, we hope you find this advice useful. A big thank you to all those who got involved - you’re the best! 
 
[h3][b]COMMUNITY TOP TIPS[/b][/h3]
 
1 - Buddy Bot - When using a Buddy Bot to transport cargo make sure you are traveling to an area covered by the Chiral Network. If not, it will cease to travel beyond the connected region. Also beware that using one as a means of travel restricts your ranking to an A at best.

Cargo Catapult- While this is intended to be a Cargo Shooting Device, it can be used offensively in very creative ways i.e. setting up traps by dropping some smoke or vog packages in MULE camps or just directly sending Cargo flying straight into them.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41741388/d7385026b19ab6d2a3897c1059adbb4067f0d00a.png[/img]
 
The Evolved Thrusters - Remember those days of Sam pitter-pattering down a steep hill with a ton of cargo strapped to his back? Well those days are gone. Now you can just gently glide down to your destination no matter how steep the terrain. Just make sure you have sufficient battery power for your descent or BB will be having a very rough day. (aadipie) 
 
2 - Use your Odradek when crossing streams! It just takes a tiny red area for you to trip and fall downstream. Not that that ever happened to me. The auto-organize is your best friend. Using it will reduce the chance of you falling by a lot. If you organized your cargo correctly, and grab your gear with both hands, don't be afraid to sprint down slopes, you'll save a lot of time that way. (Rabicho)
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41741388/993e7d48be078e90fe9ce1916119910815fe5cea.jpg[/img]
Credit: Wýstrach
 
3 - Take your time. There is no rush. Look around, enjoy the scenery. Get lost in the map, not the missions. This game to me is the best when you start choosing missions and things based on what scenery you want to see. The end of the game will come, so enjoy the journey for that is what this game amplifies. (Toxan_Eris)
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41741388/b9fa269cd20baca597bc0c65ca532f545f4ca227.jpg[/img]
Credit: The Raving Lunatic

4 - Don't underestimate the sticky gun. I didn't use it until the end of the game, and I really regret that. Make it part of your permanent loadout as soon as you get it. (Exra_)
 
5 - Craft and use every new piece of equipment you unlock. Try different routes. Avoiding loading through losses and using the in game mechanics for recovery of lost cargo. And most importantly; Likers get Likes. (Mildoze) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41741388/5b95cecd7f07d4eda501d90b293d7db9d6644cde.jpg[/img]
Credit: Trithus
 
6 - It's easier to traverse through the mountains with ziplines rather than trucks because of the rough terrain; and with DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT adding the ability for floaters to stay connected with you through ziplines, it's more justified to use them. (RurouniKukouni) 
 
7 - Use the Odradek scanner to help you go down steep slopes. There are a lot of slopes that look like they're way too steep to go down without Sam falling, but when you analyse the terrain with the scanner it's only the red parts that actually cause Sam to fall - as long as you avoid those you can make it down even the steepest slopes. (ThermalFlask) 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41741388/7592275ac81b5fefc1e1429510df038e9bb729bb.jpg[/img]
Credit: @tisi_BBKanColle
 
8 - Do timed deliveries whenever possible! There will be times where you wish you had way more stamina than you do now, so instead of getting yourself into these situations, make sure to prepare for timed deliveries and do them whenever you can. It takes a lot to rank them up, so if you make a habit of doing them, you'll be in much better shape. (watchman_5)
 
9 - Start using zip-lines mid-way through the game and make yourself a delivery network, it will make your journey so much easier, and it will help out fellow porters. They're not really needed in the early areas of the game. (Birkeland1992) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41741388/7532f5abe2ea28916606107b35b1cb0ddba9e647.png[/img]
Credit: @luckgustavo
 
[h3][b]THANK YOU, PORTERS[/b][/h3]
 
This is just a handful of advice from our amazing Porters! To view all the submissions, head on over to the DEATH STRANDING fan run subreddit: 

[url=https://www.reddit.com/r/DeathStranding/comments/t48wl6/hi_from_505_games_porters_we_want_your_help/ ]DEATH STRANDING SUBREDDIT[/url]
 
It’s been a few months now since we launched DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT on PC, so we want to take this opportunity to say thank you. Your continuous show of love and support means the world to the team at KOJIMA PRODUCTIONS and 505 Games.
 
Take care and keep on keeping on! 

- Antonela, Director of Global Community @ 505 Games

notes.title: DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR'S CUT: BEGINNER'S GUIDE
notes.content:
[h3][b]INTRODUCTION[/b][/h3]

"Once there was an explosion, a bang which gave birth to time and space.”

An explosion called the "Death Stranding" hit humanity. Civilizations and societies on Earth collapsed, people were cut off from one another and lived in isolation. With a mission to reconnect and rebuild a decimated America, as Sam Porter Bridges, you’ll travel across the North American continent from east to west to unite the divided, one step at a time.

In your mission to reconnect America, you will also build connections with other players from all over the world via DEATH STRANDING’s unique game system, the “Social Strand System”.

[b]SOCIAL STRAND SYSTEM[/b]

To provide some context around how this game system works here is an example: in your journey, you come across a mountain path that normally would be difficult to cross. But, a fellow player before you built a ladder to cross that same path, ultimately helping you in your journey. To show appreciation and recognition to a fellow player’s structure that has helped you, you can ‘like’ their structure. Likewise, a ladder or bridge that you built along your journey, might help another player in their journey as well, and they can, in turn, ‘like’ and recognize your structures also.

The intention behind the “Social Strand System” was to develop a system that creates a gentle connection between players through their actions, change the sense of gameplay, with the aim of providing a more fulfilling experience overall between players.

DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR'S CUT is the definitive DEATH STRANDING experience and adds a number of new enhancements, missions, facilities, weapons, vehicles, and more.

Attention PC Players: Having Trouble Exporting Your Save Data from DEATH STRANDING over to DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT? Scroll to the bottom of the guide for step-by-step instructions.

[h3][b]BEGINNER’S GUIDE[/b][/h3]

To help ease players or “porters” into DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT, we have prepared a mini-guide that offers tips on how to traverse the world, manage your cargo, plan your routes, as well as provide details around the new facilities, equipment and how to connect with other players.

[b]PART 1: MANAGING YOUR CARGO[/b]

Organizing and managing your cargo can improve the efficiency of making deliveries. If you load too much cargo for Sam to carry, his stamina will drain, which will affect his movement.

Accessible from the Cufflinks, go to “CARGO” to manage and adjust your cargo load.

[b]Monitor Cargo Weight and Balance[/b]

Check the cargo weight display color at the bottom of the “CARGO MANAGEMENT” screen to ensure you’re not exceeding Sam’s cargo carrying max. If the weight display remains white, this means that your cargo weight is ok and manageable. If the indicator turns yellow, this means that the weight of your cargo has increased to a level that will cause Sam to strain a bit and will adversely affect his movement. If the indicator turns red, this indicates that Sam’s cargo load is over the maximum which will greatly affect Sam’s mobility. Monitoring your cargo weight display will ensure you maintain optimal movement and performance when making deliveries.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41741388/a3ee2663d0a49a48ae17ccc3a87d72bf33870fd7.jpg[/img]

[b]Cargo Optimization[/b]

It’s best practice to ensure the placement of your cargo sits closest to the center of gravity, or central, to Sam's body, as possible.

If you need a little guidance in the beginning, from the cufflinks menu, under the “CARGO” section, select "Auto-Arrange Cargo". This function will automatically adjust your load to a more optimal state.

However, keep in mind that there are special packages such as pizza that damage if placed vertically, so be sure to also keep an eye out on the type of cargo you’re carrying as well. Some cargo does have special instructions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41741388/8e12762a6f8e25dfd600e220e1304521d70a5ed2.jpg[/img]

[b]Cargo Still Too Heavy? These Might Help![/b]

Knowing and understanding the characteristics such as weight and balance of your cargo is important and will ultimately enable you to carry and manage even more cargo. If you’re still finding cargo a bit difficult to manage though, or alternatively, you’re wanting to try and maximize your cargo load and complete multiple orders at a time, there are some equipment options that can help.

For example, equipment such as floaters and power skeletons can make it easier for you to carry more cargo, even across more complex terrains. On national roads, long-distance mass transportation is also feasible, not to mention more comfortable, on-board vehicles, such as trucks and trikes. However, these equipment types and vehicles will drain battery power, so be sure to monitor and charge your batteries when you can.

The most important thing is to deliver your package without damaging it, and as you progress through the game, you’ll discover and unlock more equipment along the way that will assist you in delivering cargo. The terrain, climate, delivery conditions, all vary and can change at any moment, so ahead of each delivery it’s important to study the map topography and the details around each order. Doing this will help you make deliveries even more efficiently.

Finding efficient and creative ways can also lead to a variety of discoveries including new areas and locations, and more!

[b]Watch Out for Cargo Deterioration[/b]

Cargo container cases can get damaged and deteriorate in a variety of different ways. “Timefall” is a form of precipitation (rain, snow, etc.) that accelerates the passage of time, or ages, objects that it comes into contact with. Falling from high distances can also damage cargo as well. In any case, it’s always good to carry a can of “Container Repair Spray” with you to repair unexpected damage to cargo cases.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41741388/d187eb52e4821380d8088d6b503f5d5da1ee9bef.jpg[/img]

[b]PART 2: PLANNING YOUR ROUTE[/b]

Studying your map and the order details for a delivery is critical in preparing for what lies ahead in the precarious world of DEATH STRANDING. Mapping your route and finding the quickest and easiest way to cross rough terrain is central to the gameplay in DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR'S CUT. Get familiar with your navigation system straight away to learn how to identify and plan your route effectively.

[b]Using Your Map[/b]

When you open the map screen, be sure to check the terrain to your destination by tilting the map. This will enable you to check the steepness of the terrain, which will aid you in planning your route ahead.

Sometimes it's faster to bypass and follow gentle terrain than to climb mountains with various height differences. Consider a route that seems easy for you to go. You can place multiple markers on the map and connect them with lines to help chart your delivery route. Guide markers also appear on the field whilst you’re playing to help you stay the course.

Switch to compass mode by pressing the “Compass” button to see your destination, and the route direction markers you’ve placed on your map, while you’re playing as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41741388/844c42b972ca206ee2608c239931326b610ca840.jpg[/img]

[b]Encountering Rugged Terrain[/b]

In the world of DEATH STRANDING, areas that can seem scenic and awe-inspiring can also have dangers lurking close by. Careful planning before you set out will always help; think ladders to climb a cliff edge, a rope to traverse rocky drops, and even Ziplines to help you slide across the skyline. However, unplanned challenges can also arise, and in some cases, you might not always have the right piece of equipment for the job. Sometimes it is helpful to look around and see what other players have left behind, it could prove useful. While these items help you overcome obstacles, they could also be your ticket to some breath-taking views.

[i]WARNING: A FEW SPOILERS AHEAD…[/i]

[b]PART 3: NEW FACILITIES[/b]

DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR'S CUT expands upon the original and introduces new facilities including a firing range and racetrack.

[b]Firing Range[/b]

In the firing range, you can practice and hone your weapon skills through a variety of drills against enemies such as MULEs and BTs. You can also participate in ranked drills and compete against other players from around the globe for the best time score.

To access this area, complete [Order No.14] at Capital Knot City [K2] or [Order No.77] at the K2 West Distribution Center. A message will be provided by Die-Hardman recommending you to use the training area. You will then be able to access the “Firing Range” from any delivery terminal of a distribution centre or safe house.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41741388/2bcff763aeeaa8d5d245dfa4180ee50eb1377e7a.jpg[/img]

[b]Racetrack[/b]

On the racetrack, you can use a variety of vehicles including trikes, trucks, even a new roadster, to time attack against other players

To access the racetracks, you must first reach Episode 3 and connect the Qpid to the “Junk Shop” Sam visits. Once you have received [Order No.35] and completed your delivery to the K4 South Distribution Center, you should receive an email from Thomas Sutherland regarding the “racetrack”. Once you have completed his request, head to the racetrack terminal located south of the Timefall Farm and deliver the following materials:

Chiral Crystals: 650
Metal: 2240
Ceramic: 1960

Once you have delivered the materials to the racetrack terminal you will have access to the racetrack. Get behind the wheel and you may be hooked on the smooth-riding.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41741388/1ac6ae7294fda8d0e9d484907a43141c7f880357.jpg[/img]

[b]PART 4: NEW WEAPONS, EQUIPMENT AND MORE[/b]

[b]Maser Gun[/b]

The maser gun is a new weapon introduced early in the game that stuns human threats such as MULE soldiers with an electric shock.

When you receive [Order No.77] at the K2 West Distribution Center, once you clear it, you will be able to obtain this weapon. If you want to practice how to use it, go to the "firing range" and try the maser gun drills.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41741388/667518bd27c530d4f109dafed990bc442cc0a115.jpg[/img]

[b]Support Skeleton[/b]

Support skeletons are new gear that support early-game delivery. Not only do they reduce the burden of carrying heavy loads, they also have a boost feature to increase your travel speed enabling you to make deliveries faster.

The boost feature does consume battery power, so be sure to monitor your batter charge meter.

The support skeleton will be available to fabricate after completing [Order No.77] which can be accessed via the terminal at the K2 West Distribution Center.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41741388/4c5ad2b0f5fa0e6600757717202188b0115ee6b5.jpg[/img]

[b]Buddy Bot[/b]

The buddy bot is a support bot that is designed to carry cargo. It can be programmed to follow and assist you in carrying cargo, or instructed to make deliveries independently.

If you need a breather, the buddy bot can be a real convenient way to move a lot of cargo and get you to the nearest facility automatically.

Keep in mind though that the buddy bot can only be used within the Chiral Network range. Additionally, if a buddy bot is used to make a delivery order, your package rating max is capped and cannot exceed an “A” grade.

The buddy bot can be accessed after clearing [Order No. 83], which is made available at the same time as [Order No.41] which can be accessed at the K4 South Distribution Center.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41741388/a8b74c670814de8672517dc1d19beac72037acb9.jpg[/img]

[b]Jump Ramp[/b]

The jump ramp is a new structure that utilizes chiral crystal energy to propel you over long distances. The chiral crystal energy also reduces the landing impact following a jump as well.

Although the jump ramp can be one solution in helping you clear obstacles that hinder your delivery, depending on the amount of airtime you get launching off a jump ramp, you can also execute some really cool tricks while you’re airborne as well!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41741388/ba7abdc85ecc9be5a05cfa55d60190b495685562.jpg[/img]

[b]Chiral Bridge[/b]

The chiral bridge helps you navigate narrow terrain and areas where a normal bridge that requires a foundation cannot be built. The chiral bridge also has a special ID to prevent the entry of MULEs soldiers and other enemies. However, be careful, the chiral bridge will become disabled if it comes into contact with “Timefall” (rain, snow).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41741388/77f67d61064d5e1597d1cb764849705282fa63c4.jpg[/img]

[b]Cargo Catapult[/b]

Cargo catapults are structures that enable you to launch cargo over long distances.  With this, you can deliver your cargo to a safe location, instead of trying to manoeuvre through challenging areas with a backpack full of cargo, such as mountain summits or huge crevasses. This new structure widens your options and opens up new ways to deliver your cargo safely and efficiently.

The cargo catapult can be accessed at the end of Episode 5 of the main story, you can build it by creating and equipping a portable chiral constructor, or PCC [Lv.2] at the distribution terminal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41741388/b115f303351f5185fe226a6ef0712c031cf8dd5c.jpg[/img]

[b]The Ruined Factory[/b]

The “Ruined Factory” is a newly added location that can be accessed when you clear both [Order No.7] and [Order No.8], both are available at the K2 West Distribution Center. Once those two orders are complete, [Order No.77] will then become available.

As you progress through the game, you'll gain deeper access into the Ruined Factory; who knows what you’ll discover?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41741388/616a7c6c57ff05fcfb721f50e8d118df44eff3cd.jpg[/img]

[b]PART 5: FAST TRAVEL[/b]

[b]Fragile Jump[/b]

Want to save a little time in travelling around the world of DEATH STRANDING? The Fragile Jump enables you to instantly transport to known centers, facilities and safe houses within the Chiral Network.

To access this feature, continue to Episode 3, highlight Fragile’s umbrella in your private room and select "Fragile Jump". A list of locations will then be made available.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41741388/675e8a8e3d4caa984cfc2dd4482e0845bc98df53.jpg[/img]

[b]PART 6: CONNECTION[/b]

In DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT, we have added new ways you can play and connect with other players.

[b]Leaderboard Rankings[/b]

You can now compete with other players in a number of ways including firing range drills, boss rematches, lap times on the racetrack, and completing ranking order requests. Challenges are updated frequently, gain rewards depending on how high you rank.

[b]Strand Contracts, Now More Convenient[/b]

After you’ve unlocked the “Bridge Links” option in the Cufflinks menu, an additional option to form strand contracts also becomes available. Strand contracts enable you to connect with other players, increasing the chances of their structures appearing in your world, and vice versa – there are a number of benefits to this.

Additionally, to make it easier to add players to your preferred contract network, a “Friend” tab has been added to the strand contract section as well.

[b]PART 7: FINALLY…[/b]

In this article, we introduced a few tips as well as some of the various elements added in DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR'S CUT that we hope can help you on your way to reconnecting the world of DEATH STRANDING.

In the real world, it can still be difficult for some to actually hold hands with friends. We hope that this work helps us all in connecting our thoughts, so that we can move the world in a good direction, even if it’s just a little.

To everyone out there, keep on keeping on.

KOJIMA PRODUCTIONS

For PC Players: Having Trouble Exporting Save Data from DEATH STRANDING over to DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT, below is a step-by-step guide:

Before you start exporting your files, please ensure you have downloaded DEATH STRANDING’s 1.07 patch.

Important: We recommend that you do not delete your base game install until you have successfully imported the converted save into DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT.

To export your save data, please follow the instructions below:

1. Launch DEATH STRANDING version 1.07 or later on your PC with internet connection.*
2. Select “Load Game” on the title screen of DEATH STRANDING and start the game from the save data you wish to export to DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT.*
3, Open Cuff Links in front of a Delivery Terminal in a facility
4. Select “SYSTEM” → “Export Save Data” (*1)
5. Details about exporting saved data will be displayed. Check the information and select “OK”.
6. At this point, saved data of the running DEATH STRANDING will be exported and saved to the local storage.
7. Launch DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT on your PC. (*2)
8. Select “Load Game (Death Stranding Save Data)” on the title screen of DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT
9. You now can play the game from DEATH STRANDING saved data stored in local storage. Also, immediately after the game starts, a new save data of DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT will be created.

(*1) In order to select “Export Save Data” on Cuff Links in DEATH STRANDING, the following conditions must be met.

* Open Cuff Links in front of a Delivery Terminal in a facility.
* Any “Orders for Sam” MUST NOT be in progress. If you have “Orders for Sam” which are in progress, please complete them all before selecting “Export Save Data”.

(*2) To load save data which was exported from DEATH STRANDING, you need to launch DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT with the same account used to export DEATH STRANDING save data.

notes.title: DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT PC COMMUNITY FAQ GUIDE
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Antonela here from 505 Games, working on DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT. On March 30th, 2022, DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT launches onto PC. As we gear up for release day, we want to give you as much info as possible in one handy Q&A guide!

Over the last few weeks we’ve received a lot of questions from our Porters, so hopefully this blog covers the vast majority of them. We will keep this guide up to date with the latest info as and when we receive commonly asked questions from the community.

Keep on keeping on!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41741388/5b6402d35b2078773bd99ce0240e9a18f1b6ba3b.jpg[/img]

[h2]PC LAUNCH INFORMATION[/h2]

[h3]When is DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT launching on Steam and the Epic Games Store?[/h3]
DEATH STRANDING Director's Cut is scheduled to launch on Steam on March 30th, 2022. 

[h3]How much will DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT cost on PC at launch? [/h3]
DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT will cost the following at launch:
£34.99
€39.99
$39.99
4980 Japanese Yen
198 Chinese Yuan

[h3]I already own DEATH STRANDING on PC. How does the upgrade to DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT work? [/h3]
To receive the upgrade for DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR'S CUT you must be logged in with the same account you purchased DEATH STRANDING with and already have it installed on your PC. When you go through to purchase the game from the PC storefront, you will be presented with the upgrade price. If you do not have DEATH STRANDING installed then you will be presented with the full price. 

[h3]Is DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT compatible with Mac or Linux?[/h3]
DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR'S CUT will not be compatible with Mac or Linux. 

[h3]Will DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT for PC include new gameplay features?[/h3]
Explore new features such as the Racetrack and Firing Rage, with extra missions and minigames. What’s more, make use of additional weapons, vehicles and new structures. And last but not least, experience an extended storyline through new missions in an expanded area.

[h3]Can I pre-purchase / pre-order DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR'S CUT on PC?[/h3]
We're not offering a pre-purchase option for DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR'S CUT but you can still get ready for launch by wishlisting the game on Steam and / or Epic Games Store. What's more, if you purchase the current version of DEATH STRANDING or already own the base game, you can upgrade to DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR'S CUT on 30th March 2022 for just $9.99.

[h3]Is DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT available to purchase in physical format?[/h3]
DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR'S CUT will only be available to purchase on PC in digital format. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41741388/872e9de0bd1d252cceeb7d242cb7d69e26e535b7.jpg[/img]

[h2]TECHNICAL QUESTIONS[/h2]

[h3]Am I able to export my game save from DEATH STRANDING to DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT?[/h3]
Yes, you will be able to export your save game files to DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT. Before you start exporting your files, please ensure you have downloaded DEATH STRANDING’s 1.07 patch.

Important: We recommend that you do not delete your base game install until you have successfully imported the converted save into DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT.

To export your save data, please follow the instructions below:

[list]
[*] Launch DEATH STRANDING version 1.07 or later on your PC with internet connection.
[*] Select "Load Game" on the title screen of DEATH STRANDING and start the game from the save data you wish to export to DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR'S CUT.
[*] Open Cuff Links in front of a Delivery Terminal in a facility
[*] Select "SYSTEM" → "Export Save Data" (*1)
[*] Details about exporting saved data will be displayed. Check the information and select "OK".
[*] At this point, saved data of the running DEATH STRANDING will be exported and saved to the local storage.
[*] Launch DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR'S CUT on your PC. (*2)
[*] Select "Load Game (Death Stranding Save Data)" on the title screen of DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR'S CUT
[*] You now can play the game from DEATH STRANDING saved data stored in local storage. Also, immediately after the game starts, a new save data of DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR'S CUT will be created.
[/list]
(*1)  In order to select "Export Save Data" on Cuff Links in DEATH STRANDING, the following conditions must be met.
・Open Cuff Links in front of a Delivery Terminal in a facility.
・Any "Orders for Sam" MUST NOT be in progress. If you have "Orders for Sam" which are in progress, please complete them all before selecting "Export Save Data".

(*2)  To load save data which was exported from DEATH STRANDING, you need to launch DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR'S CUT with the same account used to export DEATH STRANDING save data. 

[h3]Which languages does DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT support?[/h3]
DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR'S CUT will support full audio for English, French, Italian, German, Spanish (Spain & Latin America), Greek, Japanese, Polish, Portuguese, Portuguese Brazilian and Russian

The game will also support English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Czech, Dutch, Greek, Hungarian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Traditional Chinese and Turkish with subtitles.

[h3]What are the minimum / recommended specs required in order to run DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT on PC?[/h3] 
DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT PC’s minimum and recommended specs are as follows.
 
[i]MINIMUM:[/i]
OS: Windows® 10
Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-3470 or AMD Ryzen™ 3 1200
Memory: 8 GB RAM
Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050 4 GB or AMD Radeon™ RX 560 4 GB
DirectX: Version 12
Storage: 80 GB available space
Sound Card: DirectX compatible
Additional Notes: AVX instruction set required

[i]RECOMMENDED:[/i]
OS: Windows® 10
Processor: Intel™ Core i7-3770 or AMD Ryzen™ 5 1600
Memory: 8 GB RAM
Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060 6 GB or AMD Radeon™ RX 590
DirectX: Version 12
Storage: 80 GB available space
Sound Card: DirectX compatible
Additional Notes: AVX instruction set required

[h3]Does the PC edition of DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT have modding tools?[/h3]
No, the PC edition of DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR'S CUT does not have modding tools.

[h3]Does DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT have keyboard and mouse support?[/h3]
Yes, DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR'S CUT is playable with keyboard and mouse.

[h3]Does DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT have controller support?[/h3]
Yes, DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR'S CUT has full controller support.

[h3]Does DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR'S CUT on PC take advantage of Sony PlayStation's DualSense haptic feedback when connected to PC? [/h3]
Yes! Sony PlayStation’s DualSense is compatible with DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT and takes advantage of haptic feedback when connected to PC.

[h3]Does DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT on PC take advantage of Sony PlayStation's 3D audio support?[/h3]
Unfortunately, the PC version does not support Sony PlayStation's 3D audio, but some sound effects are reproduced by Ambisonics to improve the stereophonic effect.

The effect can be felt even with stereo speakers, but the 5.1 channel or 7.1 channel environment will further enhance the sense of stereophonic effect, so we encourage you all to play DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT in a multi-channel audio environment.

[h3]Will achievements also be transferred if I choose to upgrade to DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT? [/h3]
Yes! Achievements will be transferred but there are a few achievements that have changed in DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT. You will need to fulfil additional conditions in order to obtain certain achievements in DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT. 

[h3]Can we have multiple saves in DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT? Will I be able to redo the story from scratch then jump back into my main file that has near 100% completion?[/h3]
Multiple saves are possible, and it is possible to start the story over from scratch and then jump back to the main file that is near 100% completion. 

However, it is safer to save the main file that is close to 100% completion in advance when starting the story over from scratch, as the save data may be overwritten.

[h3]Will DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT be treated like a new game on Steam?[/h3]
DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR'S CUT will not overwrite DEATH STRANDING, but please be sure that if you are upgrading your save files from DEATH STRANDING to Director's Cut, you will not be able to continue playing with the save file on DEATH STRANDING.

We look forward to you all playing DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT on PC when we launch later this month!
